task_title: specs/NODE.md layer 30/90 cells name only shipped behaviour
task_criteria: Correct specs/NODE.md layer table cells 30 and 90 so each names only shipped behaviour, and add the paragraph that hands the unshipped capabilities to CF-004 and CF-068. Reproduce with: (a) `grep -n 'pull worker' specs/NODE.md` prints nothing (0 matching lines); (b) `grep -n '30 bus' specs/NODE.md` names only a crier identity file and its mode 600, `grep -n '90 verify' specs/NODE.md` names only the node manifest; (c) the paragraph names CF-004 and CF-068. Path that proves it: scripts/project-node.sh:241-252 prints only crier_identity/crier_mode for layer 30, and :288-316 prints only '[90] manifest' — run `HOME=$(mktemp -d) ./scripts/project-node.sh --check --project p --layers 30` and see the FAIL crier_identity row with no worker row. Gate: `bash tests/selftest.sh` prints SELFTEST: PASS (exit 0) and `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints RESULT: OK. Evidence file: docs/audits/code-factory-docs-2026-11-04.md, which also states what is not measured. Do NOT evaluate CF-004's unbuilt round trip or CF-068's file-existence weakness; this change is documentation-only and those rows remain open.
